purpose: Prepare a dual-receiver diagnostic for manifest-bound twelve-transmitter LoRa replay.
scientific_question: Given the same structured twelve-transmitter replay, do two independent physical receivers observe the same report structure?

RXB_TBEAM.status: pin mapping and operation to be verified during upload/test

receiver_identity_strategy: Use separate log filenames and startup/banner receiver IDs; do not add receiver ID to packet rows in v5.17.
planned_observation_classes: neither receiver relative to manifest-expected SEND opportunities
interpretation_boundaries: receiver logs are observations, not ground-truth transmitted-packet counts
missing packets do not by themselves establish a physical cause
preservation metrics are descriptive, not causal
no LoRaWAN, energy, airtime optimization, synchronized latency, wildfire deployment, or arbitrary-layout generalization claims
timestamp_matching_policy: Receiver timestamp is not a primary matching key because RXA/RXB clocks are not assumed synchronized.
planned_analysis_sequence: parse RXA raw log with existing receiver parser
parse RXB raw log with existing receiver parser
join each parsed receiver log to the fixed manifest
compute RXA-only, RXB-only, both, union, intersection, and neither-observed SEND opportunities
compare transmitter-level and report-class distributions by receiver
v5_17_scope: Design-only milestone; no physical Run 036 replay evidence and no T-Beam validation claim.
